topic: Checking In to a Self Service Cabin and Finding the Code

script.title: THE LOCKBOX CODE
script.scene_zh: 山林木屋 · 解鎖入住
script.story_hook: A code, a cold cabin, one careful phone call.
script.intro_zh: 一組密碼、一間冷木屋，一通仔細的電話。
script.welcome_en: Welcome to a mountain cabin check-in. Listen for lockbox talk.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎來到山林木屋的入住場景。留意自助入住的說法。
script.outro: Keys secured, rules clear, stars ahead. Listen again and repeat.
script.outro_zh: 鑰匙到手，規則清楚，星星在前頭。再聽一遍，跟著念。
script.practice_intro_en: Now repeat each line with us.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在跟著我們逐句重複。
script.char_a_description: a woman in her late twenties with a blunt black bob, a rust orange puffer jacket, round hoop earrings, a phone on a crossbody strap, and an average build
script.char_b_description: an older man in his early sixties with a white handlebar mustache and thinning grey hair, a thick knit cardigan over a chambray shirt, work gloves in hand, and a sturdy square build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, is this the cabin host for tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ɪz ðɪs ðə ˈkæbɪn hoʊst fɚ təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，請問是今晚小木屋的房東嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is! You're all set for tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz jʊɹ ɔl sɛt fɚ təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 是我，你們今晚都備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, we'll arrive around nine, is that okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt wil əˈɹaɪv əˈɹaʊnd naɪn ɪz ðæt oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我們大概九點到，沒問題吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Late is fine, the cabin doesn't sleep, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /leɪt ɪz faɪn ðə ˈkæbɪn ˈdʌzənt slip hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 晚到沒關係，木屋又不用睡覺，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, so where's the lockbox exactly?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜɹfɪkt soʊ wɛɹz ðə ˈlɑkˌbɑks ɪɡˈzæktli/
dialogue.zh: 好，請問鑰匙盒確切位置在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Silver box, under the railing, third step.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪlvəɹ bɑks ˈʌndɚ ðə ˈɹeɪlɪŋ θɜɹd stɛp/
dialogue.zh: 銀色盒子，欄杆下面，第三階台階。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it, is the code my booking number?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt ɪz ðə koʊd maɪ ˈbʊkɪŋ ˈnʌmbəɹ/
dialogue.zh: 記下了，密碼是我的訂單編號嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, code's four two one seven, changed today.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ koʊdz fɔɹ tu wʌn ˈsɛvən tʃeɪndʒd təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 不是，密碼是四二一七，今天剛換過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you say that once more, I'm writing?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju seɪ ðæt wʌns mɔɹ aɪm ˈɹaɪtɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 可以再說一次嗎？我正在寫下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four... two... one... seven. Slow enough?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔɹ tu wʌn ˈsɛvən sloʊ ɪˈnʌf/
dialogue.zh: 四、二、一、七。夠慢了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it now, did the old code expire, though?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt naʊ dɪd ði oʊld koʊd ɪkˈspaɪɹ ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 記好了，不過舊密碼是失效了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every guest, new code, safer for everyone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvɹi ɡɛst nju koʊd ˈseɪfəɹ fɚ ˈɛvɹiˌwʌn/
dialogue.zh: 每位房客一組新密碼，木屋安全很多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smart. Um, the door, does it stick on cold nights?
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt ʌm ðə dɔɹ dʌz ɪt stɪk ɑn koʊld naɪts/
dialogue.zh: 聰明。那冷夜裡門會不會卡住？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, lift the handle while pushing, that's the trick.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪɾəl lɪft ðə ˈhændəl waɪl ˈpʊʃɪŋ ðæts ðə trɪk/
dialogue.zh: 有一點，進門時邊抬把手邊推，這是祕訣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noted! Now, heat, is it on when we arrive?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊtəd naʊ hit ɪz ɪt ɑn wɛn wi əˈɹaɪv/
dialogue.zh: 記下了！那暖氣，我們到的時候開著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's off now, warming up by nine o'clock.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ɔf naʊ ˈwɔɹmɪŋ ʌp baɪ naɪn əˈklɑk/
dialogue.zh: 現在關著，九點會自動暖起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh nice, cabins get cold that fast, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ naɪs ˈkæbənz ɡɛt koʊld ðæt fæst raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 噢太好了，木屋涼得那麼快，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mountain air, drops ten degrees after sunset, easily.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmaʊnɪtən ɛɹ drɑps tɛn dɪˈɡriz ˈæftəɚ ˈsʌnˌsɛt ˈizəli/
dialogue.zh: 山區就是這樣，太陽一落，溫度輕鬆掉十度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our baby sleeps best in cool rooms anyway.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊəɹ ˈbeɪbi slipz bɛst ɪn kul ɹumz ˈɛniˌweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 反正我們家小寶貝在涼爽的房間最好睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, then crack a window for fresh air.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ðɛn kɹæk ə ˈwɪndoʊ fɚ fɹɛʃ ɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 那剛好，可以留條窗縫透透氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a space heater for the bedroom?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə ˈspeɪs ˈhitəɹ fɚ ðə ˈbɛdɹum/
dialogue.zh: 臥室有單獨的電暖爐嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, small one, closet, left of the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs smɔl wʌn ˈklɑzɪt lɛft ʌv ðə dɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 有，小小一台，在門左邊的衣櫥裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the hot water? Does it run fast?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə hɑt ˈwɔɾɚ dʌz ɪt ɹʌn fæst/
dialogue.zh: 那熱水呢？出得快嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tankless, instant, but give the sink ten seconds.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtæŋkləs ˈɪnstənt bʌt ɡɪv ðə sɪŋk tɛn ˈsɛkəndz/
dialogue.zh: 是即熱式的，不過水槽要等十秒才熱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Easy, and the wifi, is it strong out here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈizi ænd ðə ˈwaɪfaɪ ɪz ɪt stɹɔŋ aʊt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 簡單。那網路呢，在山區訊號強嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One bar truthfully, it's a digital detox cabin.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn bɑɹ ˈtɹʊtflɪ ɪts ə ˈdɪdʒɪɾəl ˌdiːˈtɑks ˈkæbɪn/
dialogue.zh: 老實說只有一格，這是數位排毒木屋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My teen will survive, barely, but she will.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ tin wɪl sɚˈvaɪv ˈbɛɹli bʌt ʃi wɪl/
dialogue.zh: 我家青少年會撐過去的，很勉強，但她會。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's board games, a fireplace, and real stars.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛɹz bɔɹd ɡeɪmz ə ˈfaɪɹˌpleɪs ænd ɹiəl stɑɹz/
dialogue.zh: 這裡有桌遊、壁爐，還有真正的滿天星星。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sold, that's exactly why we booked.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊld ðæts ɪɡˈzæktli waɪ wi bʊkt/
dialogue.zh: 成交，那正是我們訂房的原因。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now trash, big rule, nothing stays outside.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ træʃ bɪɡ ɹul ˈnʌθɪŋ steɪz ɑʊtˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 再來是垃圾，大規矩是：東西不留外面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bears? We saw tracks on the road in.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛɹz wi sɔw tɹæks ɑn ðə ɹoʊd ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 有熊嗎？我們開進來時在路上看到足跡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two regulars, they open bags like snack wrappers.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈɹɛɡjəɹɪz ðeɪ ˈoʊpən bæɡz laɪk snæk ˈɹæpəɹz/
dialogue.zh: 有兩隻常客，翻垃圾袋就像拆零食包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noted, all food inside, bins in the shed?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊtəd ɔl fud ɪnˈsaɪd bɪnz ɪn ðə ʃɛd/
dialogue.zh: 記下了，食物全進屋，垃圾桶放棚屋裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the shed latches, bear-proof, trust the latch.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə ʃɛd ˈlætʃəz bɛɹˌpɹuf trʌst ðə lætʃ/
dialogue.zh: 對，棚屋有門閂，防熊，記得扣好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the checkout, still eleven a.m.?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt əˈbaʊt ðə ˈtʃɛkˌaʊt stɪl ɪˈlɛvən eɪˈɛm/
dialogue.zh: 退房時間呢，還是早上十一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eleven sharp, cleaners come, it's a quiet house.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪˈlɛvən ʃɑɹp ˈklinəɹz kʌm ɪts ə ˈkwaɪət haʊs/
dialogue.zh: 十一點整，清潔人員會來，這間房子講究安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Quiet hours after ten too, for the neighbors?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkwaɪət aʊəɹz ˈæftəɚ tɛn tu fɚ ðə ˈneɪbəɹz/
dialogue.zh: 十點以後也要安靜，是為鄰居著想嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please, cabins are close, thin walls, loud boots.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz ˈkæbənz ɑɹ kloʊs θɪn wɔlz laʊd buts/
dialogue.zh: 拜託，木屋彼此很近，牆薄，靴聲傳得遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our crew is tired, we'll be ghost guests.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊəɹ kɹu ɪz ˈtaɪərd wil bi ɡoʊst ɡɛsts/
dialogue.zh: 我們這車人都累壞了，會安安靜靜像幽靈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, best guests are invisible ones, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ bɛst ɡɛsts ɑɹ ɪnˈvɪzəbəl wʌnz ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 哈，老實說，最好的房客就是看不見的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Last question, can we start a fire tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /læst ˈkwɛstʃən kæn wi stɑɹt ə ˈfaɪəɹ təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 最後一個問題，今晚可以在壁爐生火嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, deadwood only, bin by the porch steps.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈdɛdˌwʊd ˈoʊnli bɑn baɪ ðə pɔɹtʃ stɛps/
dialogue.zh: 可以，只燒枯枝，木桶就在門廊階梯旁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to crack the flue first?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tə kɹæk ðə flu fɜɹst/
dialogue.zh: 要先開煙道閘門嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open it fully, else the room fills with smoke.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən ɪt ˈfʊli ɛls ðə ɹum fɪlz wɪð smoʊk/
dialogue.zh: 要全開，不然房間會充滿煙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Learned that the smoky way at my grandma's.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɜrnd ðæt ðə ˈsmoʊki weɪ æt maɪ ˈɡɹæməz/
dialogue.zh: 我在阿嬤家學過這課，嗆到流眼淚的那種。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, the tearful apprenticeship, we all pass through.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ðə ˈtɪɹfəl əˈpɹɛnɪʃɪp wi ɔl pæs θɹu/
dialogue.zh: 哈，流淚學來的技藝，人人都要過這關。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the firewood stack enough for two nights?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈfaɪəɹˌwʊd stæk ɪˈnʌf fɚ tu naɪts/
dialogue.zh: 那一堆柴夠燒兩個晚上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plenty, plus extra logs behind the shed wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈplɛnti plʌz ˈɛkstɹə lɔɡz bɪˈhaɪnd ðə ʃɛd wɔl/
dialogue.zh: 很夠，棚屋牆後另有一堆備用柴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, you two run this place together?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ju tu ɹʌn ðɪs pleɪs təˈɡɛðəɹ/
dialogue.zh: 等等，這地方是你們兩人一起經營的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, my wife and I, thirty years.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs maɪ waɪf ænd aɪ ˈθɜɹti jɪɹz/
dialogue.zh: 對，我和太太一起經營，已經三十年。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thirty years means you've seen every guest mistake.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜɹti jɪɹz minz juv sin ˈɛvɹi ɡɛst mɪˈsteɪk/
dialogue.zh: 三十年的經驗，什麼房客犯的錯都看過了吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave the flue closed, that's the classic one.
dialogue.phonetic: /liv ðə flu kloʊzd ðæts ðə ˈklæsɪk wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 最經典的錯誤就是忘記開煙道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll open it before I light anything, promise.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl ˈoʊpən ɪt bɪˈfɔɹ aɪ laɪt ˈɛnɪθɪŋ pɹɑmɪs/
dialogue.zh: 我保證先開煙道，再點任何東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And text me anything, I answer fast, really.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd tɛkst mi ˈɛnɪθɪŋ aɪ ˈænsəɹ fæst ˈɹiəli/
dialogue.zh: 有狀況隨時傳訊息給我，我回覆真的很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's comforting, the cabin's ninety minutes away now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈkʌmfəɹtɪŋ ðə ˈkæbənz ˈnaɪnti ˈmɪnəts əˈweɪ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 聽了就安心，木屋只剩九十分鐘車程。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drive slow, deer cross at that last bend.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɹaɪv sloʊ dɪɹ kɹɔs æt ðæt læst bɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢開，最後那個彎常有鹿衝出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Copy that: lockbox, four-two-one-seven, heat, shed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɑpi ðæt ˈlɑkˌbɑks fɔɹ tu wʌn ˈsɛvən hit ʃɛd/
dialogue.zh: 收到：鑰匙盒、四二一七、暖氣、棚屋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're ready, better than most, welcome to Pine Hollow.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ˈɹɛdi ˈbɛɾəɹ ðæn moʊst ˈwɛlkəm tə paɪn ˈhɑloʊ/
dialogue.zh: 你準備得比多數人都周全，松谷木屋等你們來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you, we'll be the invisible guests, promise.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju wil bi ði ɪnˈvɪzəbəl ɡɛsts pɹɑmɪs/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，我們會安靜得像是隱形人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See you at the cabin, keep the stars close.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ju æt ðə ˈkæbɪn kip ðə stɑɹz kloʊs/
dialogue.zh: 木屋見，讓滿天星星陪著你們。

script.youtube_title: 【深夜木屋自助入住🌲】「木屋又不用睡覺」一通電話教你鎖碼、暖氣、垃圾規則🔐🎧｜聽完就會自己入住｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Self Check-In Cabin Call
script.youtube_title_en: The Cabin Doesn't Sleep — Self Check-In, Lockbox Codes and Cabin Rules
script.youtube_description:
「木屋又不用睡覺」——深夜抵達山野木屋，怎麼用一通電話搞定鑰匙盒密碼、暖氣、垃圾規則和安靜退房？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在深夜抵達、訊號微弱的山林木屋。

你會聽到：確認晚到沒問題、逐位複誦四位數密碼、問門卡住怎麼開；暖氣幾點自動開、電暖器放哪裡、熱水要等幾秒；還有防熊垃圾規則、煙道要不要開、十一點安靜退房的完整對答。

全篇使用 A2 初級單字與短句，充滿電話對話的真實語感：um、oh、ha、right?、honestly。聽完你就會說：Can you say that once more、where's the lockbox、is it strong out here、what about the checkout。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，大聲跟著念，讓舌頭先跟上，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請訂閱並開啟小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"The cabin doesn't sleep" — how do you check in to a mountain cabin at night with just one phone call? This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice covering lockbox codes, heating, and cabin rules.

You will hear: confirming a late arrival, repeating a four-digit code, the trick for a sticky door; asking when the heat turns on, where the space heater lives, how long the hot water takes; plus bear-proof trash rules, fireplace flue tips, and a quiet eleven o'clock checkout.

Everything stays in A2-level words, with real phone-call rhythm: um, oh, ha, right?, honestly. By the end you'll own lines like Can you say that once more, Where's the lockbox, and What about the checkout.

The back half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.
